bayts.text: You have already come between me and all that You have not approved for me: so increase the learned through me.
Bless with a blessing that completes my outward, beautifying, and beautifies my inward,
with a peace that leads my limbs to good in the mornings and evenings (Qurʾān 7:205),
upon him who has already come, forever, between me and whoever refused to worship.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have given me mastery over my soul with my desire, and You lead to me what my supplication required.
You have led to me the goods of Your world, and led to me with good pleasure Your second (reward, the Hereafter).
You have driven corruptions toward other than my person, and led to me the greatest in my delights.
Bless with a blessing that bears witness for me to my contentment with You, and to an increase from You,
with a peace that makes certainty eternal for me, by which You make me the joy of the God-fearing,
upon him whom my balance visits at every hour, without sorrows.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And come between me and evil through him, forever, O You Who take away the evildoer.
And join me through him to all that gladdens me of wishes, greeting with peace.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have removed the Fire by grace toward others than me, and led to me the dirham and the dīnār.
And for me You have blessed both, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ), O You Who make my grace clear.
And You have come forever between me and that from which refuge is sought in You, as a help.
Bless with a blessing that drives every corrupt thing toward other than my person, that perpetuates for me the gain of the market
without departing, with a surpassing peace that bestows on me forever what is fitting,
upon him through whom You made my affirmation of Your Oneness sound for me, Your unique Messenger,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
as through him You have realised for me a union befitting me; and spare me separation.
O You Who make my writing above my own estimate and the estimate of others than me, O Mighty in favour.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have granted me my request and what surpasses the desired, without objection, and unveiled the aim for me.
Bless with a blessing that bears witness to success for me, with a peace that bears witness to righteousness
for me, upon him through whom You spared me the Accursed and what You did not approve for me, O Helper.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness to my gratitude to You on this day and after it, O You Who protected from blame.
You conveyed to me, You taught me, You explained to me; there is no doubt in what You bestowed on me from Your loftiness.
You softened for me without harm, You gladdened me, You made gentle for me, You honoured me, You praised me.
You extended for me, You made easy for me, You gave me dominion, You effaced what grieves me, You established me.
Take away (evil) through him, and bestow preservation on me, and extend good to me without shock.
Make the dominion abide for me, and bless on my behalf, greeting with peace, the Prophet, and be for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have made me attain triumph and an intellect that protects from whoever shows himself forever an adversary.
Bless with a blessing that never ceases to open for us the gates of the Gardens by the Fātiḥa,
with a peace that turns toward others than us the gates of the fires and makes our good abide,
upon him through whom You granted me the Book, as he spared me reproach.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me through him what I used to long for of wishes, without toil, O Generous,
and without affliction and without turbidity, and be for me with gladness, O Possessor of power.
And grant me what is not seen for others than me, in Allah, in the Remembrance and in the "ear of good" (Qurʾān 9:61),
— may Allah bless him with peace — in the Family and the Companions possessed of knowledge.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have awakened me with the awakening of an Appreciative, All-Knowing, Everlasting One, Who led benefit to me with the sciences.
To You is due from me gratitude from Shaʿbān, before it and after it, as an offering of nearness.
Bless with a blessing that leads to me the recovery of what has escaped me, that fills my heart with wisdoms,
with a peace that draws for me the blessings of what You chose for me; that settles for me the movements
and my stillnesses in the greatest good pleasure, without tremor or aggression,
upon him whom my life gladdens, and You led the signs to me by his standing.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
